title: Plan limits, account emails and hosting extensions

scenarios.name: Base limit as owner
scenarios.checked: Dev test plan with 3 bases per workspace; creating an eighth base in a workspace with 7 answers 402 and the dialog shows "This plan allows 3 bases per workspace" with an Upgrade button that opens Settings, Billing

scenarios.name: Record limit as owner and as a member
scenarios.checked: Dev test plan with 50 records per base; adding a record to a base with 1,003 records is refused as a whole (the count stays 1,003); the owner's toast has Upgrade, an editor's toast says "Ask a workspace owner to upgrade."

scenarios.name: CSV import over the limit
scenarios.checked: A 60-record CSV into a base with room for 39 is refused with "This plan allows 50 records per base; 39 more can be added" before the table is created

scenarios.name: Usage notice at 80%
scenarios.checked: Home shows the limits at or over 80% (bases 7 of 3, records 1,003 of 50) with See plans for the owner and "Ask a workspace owner to upgrade." for an editor

scenarios.name: Billing tab
scenarios.checked: Settings, Billing shows the hosting's plan, usage bars for the five limits, a notice, a note section and its buttons; Upgrade (test) POSTs and follows the returned URL to the paid plan with raised limits, and back

scenarios.name: Password reset by email
scenarios.checked: Forgot password? on the login page sends a reset email through a local SMTP server (wrangler dev and the Docker server); the link opens Choose a new password, which sets it and signs the browser in; the same link a second time is refused

scenarios.name: Email confirmation
scenarios.checked: An unconfirmed account sees Check your inbox to confirm your email; Send again mails a new link; opening it shows Email confirmed and sets the account confirmed; reusing it answers "This link is invalid or has expired"

title: Email code sign-in and sign-in options

scenarios.name: Sign up with an email code
scenarios.checked: Code mode with mail to a local SMTP server: the page asks only for an email, the 6-digit code arrives, entering it creates the account and its workspace and opens Home

scenarios.name: Join from an invite with a code
scenarios.checked: A signed-out person opens an invite, asks for a code, uses Send a new code and enters the newest code: they join the workspace as an editor and get no workspace of their own

scenarios.name: No passwords anywhere in code mode
scenarios.checked: /forgot goes to the sign-in page, Settings, Account has no Password section, and the password routes answer 404

scenarios.name: Readable sign-in errors
scenarios.checked: /login?error=Sign-in was cancelled. shows the text above the form

scenarios.name: Password mode unchanged
scenarios.checked: Without AUTH_EMAIL the log-in page still has Email, Password, Forgot password? and Sign up, and config reports no sign-in options
